title: Kristal-Catho — Vatican-recognised authors and works · complete campaign
scope_context: Read the existing Catholic recognition roster; identify people in local Wikidata; find P50 authored works; extract all resolved full Wikidata records with provenance. No false claims of Catholicity or magisterial endorsement.
notes: One-click campaign: persons -> safe QID identity resolution -> incoming P50 works -> deduplicated inventory -> full source JSON.
Primary: 38 Doctors of the Church and Ratzinger Prize laureates. Announced 2026 prize is not treated as already conferred.
Supporting: members of the International Theological Commission and Pontifical Academy of Saint Thomas (historical membership; not universal doctrinal endorsement).
Popes are deliberately excluded by default: pontifical office is a distinct category, not proof of individual text authorship.
Not all prize laureates are Catholics. Names that are absent or ambiguous will remain unresolved and get an explicit report.
No geographic exclusion, no automated doctrinal claims, no changes to the Kristal canon.
